cards.ex: Oops, I spilled your coffee. My bad!
cards.exUz: Voy, men sening kofeingni to'kib yubordim. Mening aybim!
cards.uzDef: "Mening aybim" degani, xato qildim va aybdor ekanligimni tan olaman degani.

cards.ex: Thanks for covering for me at the meeting. I owe you one.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvda meni himoya qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Men sizdan qarzdorman.
cards.uzDef: Sizga yaxshilik qilishim kerak, sizga yordam berganingiz uchun minnatdorchilik bildirish.

cards.ex: He apologized, so just let it go and move on.
cards.exUz: U kechirim so'radi, shuning uchun shunchaki unutib, davom eting.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xato yoki muammolarni unutib, davom etish, kechirish.

cards.ex: He wants to make amends for his past mistakes.
cards.exUz: U o'zining o'tmishdagi xatolari uchun tovon to'lamoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish uchun tovon to'lash, xatoni tuzatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: They're trying to patch things up after their argument.
cards.exUz: Ular janjaldan keyin munosabatlarini tiklashga harakat qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni tiklash, urushdan keyin yarashish.

cards.ex: It happened a long time ago. Just get over it!
cards.exUz: Bu ancha oldin sodir bo'lgan. Shunchaki unuting!
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qayg'urishni to'xtatish, o'tmishni unutish.

cards.ex: I believe in forgive and forget, so let's move forward.
cards.exUz: Men kechirish va unutishga ishonaman, shuning uchun keling, oldinga siljiymiz.
cards.uzDef: Kechirish va o'tmishdagi xatolarni eslamaslik.

cards.ex: It's time to bury the hatchet and work together.
cards.exUz: Uruşni to'xtatib, birgalikda ishlash vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etgan janjalni to'xtatish, yarashtirish.

cards.ex: My sincere apologies for the misunderstanding.
cards.exUz: Tushunmovchilik uchun chin dildan kechirim so'rayman.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy afsusda ekanligingizni bildirish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

cards.ex: He tried to atone for his mistakes by working harder.
cards.exUz: U ko'proq ishlash orqali o'z xatolaridan poklanishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish uchun azob chekish yoki to'lov to'lash orqali gunohdan poklanish.

cards.ex: I bumped my knee, but I'll just walk it off.
cards.exUz: Tizzamni urib oldim, lekin shunchaki e'tibor bermayman.
cards.uzDef: Kichik muammoga e'tibor bermaslik, o'tib ketishiga umid qilish.

cards.ex: I said I was sorry, so just get off my back!
cards.exUz: Men kechirim so'radim, shuning uchun shunchaki boshimni qotirma!
cards.uzDef: Meni tinch qo'y, meni bezovta qilma.

cards.ex: I almost dropped the cake, but no harm, no foul.
cards.exUz: Men deyarli tortni tushirib yubordim, lekin zarar yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Agar hech kim zarar ko'rmagan bo'lsa, xato muhim emas.

cards.ex: You need to put the past behind you and focus on the future.
cards.exUz: O'tmishni unutib, kelajakka e'tibor qaratishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani unutish va davom etish.

cards.ex: They fell out with each other over a business deal.
cards.exUz: Ular biznes bitimi tufayli bir-birlari bilan urushib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan janjallashib, munosabatlarni buzish.

cards.ex: Let's have a meeting to clear the air after the argument.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin munosabatlarni yaxshilash uchun uchrashuv o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Noaniqlik yoki tushunmovchilikni bartaraf etish, munosabatlarni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: I need to get something off my chest – I'm not happy here.
cards.exUz: Men bir narsani aytishim kerak - men bu erda baxtli emasman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida gapirib, o'zingizni yengil his qilish.

cards.ex: I don't hold grudges; I try to forgive people.
cards.exUz: Men xafalik saqlamayman; men odamlarni kechirishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida kimdandir xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: Mea culpa! I completely forgot about our appointment.
cards.exUz: Mening aybim! Men uchrashuvimizni butunlay unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Latincha ibora, "Mening aybim" degan ma'noni anglatadi, xatoni tan olish.

cards.ex: Sometimes it's better to turn the other cheek than to argue.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan bahslashishdan ko'ra sabr qilish yaxshiroqdir.
cards.uzDef: Haqoratga sabr qilish, javob qaytarmaslik.

cards.ex: He tried to apologize, but she just brushed him off.
cards.exUz: U kechirim so'rashga harakat qildi, lekin u shunchaki unga e'tibor bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga e'tibor bermaslik, ahamiyat bermaslik.

cards.ex: She took the blame for the mistake to protect her friend.
cards.exUz: U do'stini himoya qilish uchun xato uchun aybdorlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish uchun aybdorlikni o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: He had to beg forgiveness after his terrible behavior.
cards.exUz: U dahshatli xatti-harakatidan keyin kechirim so'rashga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Haqoratli xatti-harakat uchun juda iltimos qilib kechirim so'rash.

cards.ex: She's finally made peace with her past.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat o'tmishi bilan yarashdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan kelishishga harakat qilish, qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves a second chance.
cards.exUz: Hamma ham ikkinchi imkoniyatga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilgan kishiga yana bir imkoniyat berish.

cards.ex: It's time to put it behind us and move forward.
cards.exUz: Buni ortda qoldirib, oldinga siljish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muammoni unutish va davom etish.

cards.ex: I don't want to talk about it, so let's just drop the subject.
cards.exUz: Men bu haqda gaplashmoqchi emasman, shuning uchun keling, mavzuni yopamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida gapirishni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: He offered a heartfelt apology for his mistake.
cards.exUz: U xatosi uchun chin dildan kechirim so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Chin dildan, samimiy kechirim so'rash.

cards.ex: He spent his life atoning for his sins.
cards.exUz: U umrini gunohlarini yuvishga sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilganidan so'ng, xatoni tuzatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: They offered an olive branch to end the conflict.
cards.exUz: Ular mojaroni tugatish uchun yarashuv taklifini berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuv yoki tinchlik taklifini berish.
